blind.description: A low topiary hedge shaped into an arched portal or doorway. It consists of two rectangular vertical pillar sections supporting an arched connecting top with slightly undulating, rounded foliage contours. The surface has a leaf/foliage texture with visible organic leaf-like clusters and small woody branch/stem hints near the base opening. The mesh is continuous and solid with no floating disconnected flakes or holes, sitting directly flat on the ground on its two pillar bases without any artificial base plate.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as an elongated rectangular green strip with rounded, undulating edges, slightly pinched in thickness in the middle arch section and wider at the pillar ends.
blind.height_vs_figure: The arch is approximately 3.5 to 4 feet tall (roughly two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 4.5 to 5 feet wide.
